disabled_failed_toolsets.text:
# Disabled & failed Toolsets
These toolsets are DISABLED (unconfigured) unless marked FAILED (misconfigured). Setup docs per toolset: `https://holmesgpt.dev/data-sources/builtin-toolsets/<name before any slash>/` unless a different URL is given.

truncation_instruction.text: * If a query returns too much data (e.g. truncation error), you MUST retry with a more specific query, fewer data points, or topk/bottomk. NEVER answer based on truncated Prometheus data — you might be missing the information that changes the answer. Prefer saying you can't answer (and showing the user a graph via the promql embed so they can interpret it themselves) over answering from incomplete data.
